messages.text: Hey! Quick question, what time do you guys open tomorrow? I'm thinking of swinging by for a cappuccino.
Hello! We open bright and early at 7:00 AM most days. If tomorrow is Friday, we are open until 8:00 PM, and we would be happy to make you a wonderful cappuccino for $3.80!
Oh, thanks! I come in way too often to not check the hours. So just to be sure, what time do you guys open on Saturday?
Good morning! We open at 8:00 AM on Saturday. We look forward to seeing you then, and we'll be happy to serve you a delicious cappuccino for $3.80!
I'm planning to swing by again soon, so I wanted to check the schedule. What time do you open on Sunday?
We are closed on Sunday, but we would be delighted to have you stop by bright and early on Monday starting at 7:00 AM! We hope you can make it in then for a delicious treat.
